critique.evidence: Reduced-motion behavior is correctly proven at all three viewports: mediaMatches is true and the hero remains at opacity 1 with no transform. Tablet and mobile timing is near 60 fps with no long frames, but desktop averages 22.36 ms per frame, with a 50 ms worst frame. More importantly, the measured midpoint is already effectively identical to the end state at every viewport—opacity about 0.45 and the full matrix3d/−30 px transform—so the transition lacks a demonstrable smooth intermediate progression.
critique.fix: Retune the animation duration/easing so the midpoint is visibly intermediate rather than effectively complete, then recapture start, quarter, midpoint, three-quarter, and end frames. Profile the desktop path to bring average frame time closer to 16.7 ms and eliminate the 50 ms spike while preserving the verified reduced-motion override.
